parts.when: [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit selects its targets.
parts.target: A **THOUSAND SONS** unit of yours that any of those attacks target.
parts.effect: Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed** before it has fought this phase, roll a D6, adding 1 if the unit is wholly within the [Flow of Magic](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.hexwarp-thrallband.flow-of-magic) of your army. On a 4+, leave the model on the battlefield: it can fight after the enemy unit finishes attacking, and is then removed. This lasts for the rest of the phase.

data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit selects its targets.

**Target:** A **THOUSAND SONS** unit of yours that any of those attacks target.

**Effect:** Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed** before it has fought this phase, roll a D6, adding 1 if the unit is wholly within the [Flow of Magic](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.hexwarp-thrallband.flow-of-magic) of your army. On a 4+, leave the model on the battlefield: it can fight after the enemy unit finishes attacking, and is then removed. This lasts for the rest of the phase.
